recipes.name: Refreshing Melon Cucumber Soda
instructions: Add the melon, lime juice, and ginger to a blenderand blend until smooth.
To create an optional decorative rim, run a lime wedge around the rims of your serving glasses. Pour some sugar on a small plate and dip the edge of the glass in the sugar.
Divide the ice between the glasses. Top with cucumber slices. Pour over two parts blended melon mixture to one part carbonated water. Add agave syrup to taste, and enjoy!
